name: What is the proper order of steps during an interior finish upgrade?

mainEntity.name: What is the proper order of steps during an interior finish upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper sequencing prevents newly finished surfaces from being damaged by subsequent work. The typical process starts with demolition and rough carpentry or framing modifications, followed by electrical or plumbing adjustments inside the walls. Next, drywall is hung, taped, mudded, and sanded to a smooth finish. Once walls are prepped, custom tile work and finish carpentry—including doors, baseboards, and casing—are installed. Interior painting and final touch-ups occur last to ensure crisp, clean cut lines and pristine trim finishes across the entire room.
acceptedAnswer.description: Work flows from framing to rough-in sub-trades, followed by drywall installation, custom tile setting, finish carpentry, and finally priming, painting, and trim touch-ups.
